review.notes: Triage review: full structural/fence scan (all fences balanced, no swallowed headings/tables/images); automated whole-document page-text diff (normalized 4-gram containment per page) with manual inspection of every page below 0.90 coverage, plus decimal-number completeness checks on all table-heavy pages (8-10, 12-14, 16, 23-26, 37, 71-73: zero missing values). Rendered pages 19, 66, 78, 79, 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, 88, 89, 90 were visually inspected, with 300 dpi crops for names and headings. The appendix (physical pages 76-90) renders each conversation as an embedded screenshot image, so prompt/response text existing only inside those embeds is not treated as droppage; the appendix section headings, however, are printed document structure and 10.4.3-10.5, 10.6.2 lost their heading prefixes in OCR, the 10.6 parent heading was dropped entirely, and demo-box labels were glued onto two headings. Contributor names on page 66 verified at 300 dpi.
